descriptionHtml:
要人拍板 D6 · P1 · Daniela

转录 / 保留时长和 UAT 3.6 不一致：归档 48 小时（不是 36）、养老院保留 3 次访视（不是 2 次）、「Earlier sessions」和「Most Recent」不带日期、快速口述框永不过期、保留时长写死在代码里（是不是要做成配置）

同一个问题的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-16/S10, TC-16/S11, TC-16/S14, TC-16/S27, OAT-04/S19, TC-11/S28, TC-04/S10

思路 / Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S23 「转写的保留窗口是配置值（3.6）」 Transcript retention windows are configuration values (3.6)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U10 The transcript retention windows are configuration values, not hard-coded, so they can be lengthened later.（UAT 3.6；UAT OAT-04 (B)）

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given convex/lib/lifecycle.ts HOSPITAL_RETENTION (encounter 18 h, encounterArchive 48 h) and SNF_RETENTION (encounter 12 h, transcriptVisits 3)

When Review where the windows are defined and how they would be lengthened under a hospital affiliation

Then Each transcript window can be changed as runtime configuration without a code change and deploy, and the values match 3.6

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Pass only if each transcript window (Hospital encounter 18 h and the archive / yesterday window, Nursing Home 12 h and the visit count) is read from runtime configuration (an env var or a settings row) that can be changed without a code deploy, and its value matches 3.6. A window defined only as a source constant is a Fail. …

在哪跑：本地 code-review（读代码判）；测试方法 CODEREVIEW · 代码审查；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S23 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-16.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条；要拍板的人：Daniela；Allure 状态按分诊从 unknown 改成 failed。

问题分类：要人拍板（Daniela） · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-94699 in progress

转录保留期只能改代码、重新部署才能调，其中两个值和 UAT 3.6 不一样：归档 48 小时（不是 36），养老院保留 3 次访视（不是 2 次）。

Transcript retention can only be changed with a code change and deploy, and two of the values differ from UAT 3.6: the archive is 48 h instead of 36 h, and Nursing Home keeps 3 visits instead of 2.

依据：Allure de9b7cfc, code-review fail-pending-Q3+Q10+Q14. HOSPITAL_RETENTION and SNF_RETENTION are `as const` objects in lifecycle.ts:8-38. Recorded gaps: known:transcript-consts (Q14), known:archive-48h (Q10), known:visits-3 (Q3). The ticket map lists no ticket (UAT only); TFA-94699 AC 7 ('windows are config values') owns this.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane code-review。

测试方法：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查；辅助：CONFIG · 配置核对 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：code-review。

UAT item: TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · Section: A3 · Encounter · Scenario: TC-16/S23

Transcript retention windows are configuration values (3.6)

Tickets: none (UAT only)

本地新 lane code-review：code-review/results.json 里 status fail-pending-Q3+Q10+Q14 → 待人看（只在开放问题 Q3+Q10+Q14 上失败，还不算失败 → 待人看）。

Detail:

All four transcript windows are hard-coded source constants in apps/web/convex/lib/lifecycle.ts, held in two `as const` objects. HOSPITAL_RETENTION (lines 8-28) sets the encounter window to 18 h and the archive window (encounterArchive) to 48 h. SNF_RETENTION (lines 30-38) sets the encounter window to 12 h and transcriptVisits to 3. The lifecycle functions read these constants directly (lines 152, 171, 318, 336-337). I found no environment variable or settings row for retention anywhere in convex/, so lengthening any window means changing the code and deploying it. Against UAT 3.6: the Hospital encounter window (18 h) and the Nursing Home window (12 h) match. The archive window is 48 h, not 36 h, and the visit count is 3, not 2. Every failing point is a recorded gap whose verdict waits on an open question: known:transcript-consts (Q14), known:archive-48h (Q10) and known:visits-3 (Q3). So the verdict is pending, not fail. If Q14 accepts a named source constant, the configuration half passes and only the two values remain to judge.

等开放问题（pendingOn）：

  • Q3
  • Q10
  • Q14

确认的已知缺口（knownGapsConfirmed）：

  • apps/web/convex/lib/lifecycle.ts:8: Hospital transcript windows are a source constant object, not runtime configuration
  • apps/web/convex/lib/lifecycle.ts:23: Hospital archive (yesterday) window is 48 h, but 3.6 says 36 h
  • apps/web/convex/lib/lifecycle.ts:30: Nursing Home windows are a source constant object, not runtime configuration
  • apps/web/convex/lib/lifecycle.ts:35: Nursing Home keeps 3 transcript visits, but 3.6 says the last two
  • apps/web/convex/lib/lifecycle.ts:171: The archive window is read straight from the constant; nothing is looked up at runtime
  • apps/web/convex/lib/lifecycle.ts:337: The Nursing Home visit count is read straight from the constant
  • apps/web/convex/lib/lifecycle.ts:8: The Hospital retention windows are a hard-coded `as const` source object, not runtime configuration.
  • apps/web/convex/lib/lifecycle.ts:23: The Hospital archive (yesterday) transcript window is 48 h, but 3.6 says 36 h.
  • apps/web/convex/lib/lifecycle.ts:30: The Nursing Home retention windows are a hard-coded source object, so changing them needs a code change and a deploy.
  • apps/web/convex/lib/lifecycle.ts:35: The Nursing Home transcript visit count is 3, but 3.6 says the last two.

开放问题（openQuestions）：

  • Q14: is a named source constant (HOSPITAL_RETENTION / SNF_RETENTION) enough to count as 'configuration'? If yes, the configuration half passes.
  • Q10: should the Hospital archive window be 36 h, as 3.6 says, or 48 h, as the code has it?
  • Q3: should Nursing Home keep transcripts for 2 visits, as 3.6 says, or 3, as the code has it?
  • Q12: which of the prototype's own values apply? I did not compare against the prototype.
  • Q10: is the archive window 48 h (code) or 36 h (3.6)?
  • Q3: does the Nursing Home keep 3 visit transcripts (code) or the last two (3.6)?
  • Q12: should the prototype's own values be the reference?
  • The oracle and the question agree: the question's fail rule would give 'fail', but every failing point here is handed to an open question, so the oracle's verdict is pending.

代码定不了（notDecidableByCode）：

  • Whether a named source constant meets U10's 'configuration value' (Q14)
  • Which archive window and visit count are correct (Q10, Q3, Q12)
  • Whether Daniela accepts a named source constant as configuration (Q14).
  • Which archive window and visit count are intended (Q10, Q3, Q12).

对医生的影响（physicianImpact）：Hospital transcripts from the previous day stay available for 48 h, not 36 h, and Nursing Home residents keep three visits of transcripts instead of two. Changing any of these windows, for example for a hospital affiliation, needs a code change and a deploy; an admin cannot adjust them. / A Hospital physician can still see yesterday's transcript for 48 h, not 36 h, and a Nursing Home physician keeps the last three visit transcripts, not two. An admin cannot lengthen any window for a hospital affiliation without a developer changing code and redeploying.

审查结论（verdict）：fail

证据：附了 2 个。

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: outside-runner (manual: doc-review). This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
